messages:
amy: Heads-up — scheduling an EU edge routing policy swap tonight at 02:00 UTC. Plan: soft rollout 40% for 30m, then 75% for 15m, then 100% if no issues. Need a deployer, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Will also watch tracing for `route=nudge-v2`.

jordan: I'm the primary deployer. I can kick off at 02:00 and stay on monitoring. @ops-oncall please stand by for rollback.

ops-oncall: Oncall here, available 01:45-03:30 UTC. I'll watch p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, origin errors. Recommend alerts on 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms.

sanjay: Quick preflight notes: healthprobe TTL = 30s validated, origin keepalives ok. One config question: new policy sets `weighted-host` header, confirm header passthrough from edge -> origin.

lee: Confirmed header passthrough is enabled. CDN caching prefixes unchanged. I can run the auth/e2e smoke flows during the canary windows.

jordan: deploy-bot: requesting schedule for 02:00 UTC rollout (eu region).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by jordan at 02:00 UTC. Automated canary pauses at each stage (40%, 75%) for 5 minutes pending manual `continue`. Rollback window attached.

amy: Short smoke checklist (callouts):
- run `curl -I https://eu-edge.example.com/health` against canary IPs and compare response headers (expect `x-route: nudge-v2`).
- login + checkout flow (auth tokens).
- validate tracing tag `route=nudge-v2` shows up in spans.
- check latency SLOs (p50/p95) and error rates in Grafana.
I'll take health + tracing.

lee: I'll run auth + end-to-end checkout flows during the 40% window. Ping me @jordan when you move to 40%.

jordan: Prep: updating rollout script and will post a short play-by-play. Command I'll run: `./scripts/rollout.sh --env=prod --region=eu --stages=40,75,100 --pause=5m`

ricardo: FYI DNS TTL stays 60s for this change, so expect some slow convergence on older resolvers — metrics might lag by a minute or two.

sanjay: Rollback plan in repo: `ops/rollbacks/rollback-policy --region=eu --policy=previous`. I ran a dry-run earlier — should be <3m to revert.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll open #inc-eu-rollout if thresholds trigger and coordinate rollback.

amy: Thanks — I'll be watching from 01:50-03:30. Please leave a short +1 when you confirm ownership for your tasks.

jordan: +1 (deploy + play-by-play)

lee: +1 (auth/e2e smoke)

sanjay: +1 (rollback ready, config checks)

amy: Great. I'll post a final readiness ping 01:55 UTC and again when we hit 40%.
